stylePrompt: Use the declared styleFamily for each item and choose subjects from people, communities, animals, plants, landscapes, weather, tools, vehicles, buildings and everyday objects according to the scene. Keep one coherent style inside each image while varying styles across the batch. Shared constraints: mature learner-facing art direction, landscape 3:2 composition, a clear focal action or relationship, no in-image teaching text, and no live-action or realistic-human impression. When people appear, every readable foreground or midground face must have clearly rendered natural eyes, a nose, a mouth and a scene-appropriate expression. Never use blank oval faces, featureless masks, mannequin heads or shadows that erase the facial features. Vary age, skin tone, facial structure, body type, hairstyle, clothing, ability and occupation naturally. No realistic skin pores, photographic faces, stock-photo staging, logos, watermarks, readable interfaces, chibi proportions or glossy toy rendering.

items.sentenceEn: Each wooden cube is a separate storage unit.
items.sentenceZh: 每个木方格都是一个独立的储物单元。
items.scene: A modular storage wall consists of six clearly separate wooden cube units fitted together. One adult craftsperson slides exactly one cube out from the larger arrangement, making the single unit and whole system relationship unmistakable.
items.altText: 六个独立木方格组成储物墙，工匠正抽出其中一个单元。

items.sentenceEn: Her paintings have a bold geometric style.
items.sentenceZh: 她的画具有鲜明的几何风格。
items.scene: An adult artist works in a studio where three finished canvases share the same unmistakable visual style: bold geometric shapes, strong flat colors and rhythmic angular patterns. Her current canvas continues the same coherent approach without symbols or text.
items.altText: 画室里三幅作品都使用鲜明色块和几何图形，呈现统一风格。

items.meaningZh: 成人；成虫；成年的；成熟的
items.sentenceEn: Every child travels with an adult.
items.sentenceZh: 每个孩子都由一名成人陪同出行。
items.scene: At a train platform, one clearly mature adult walks between two school-age children, holding one child's hand and guiding both toward the train. Differences in height, facial maturity and caring responsibility distinguish the adult without exaggeration.
items.altText: 一名成年人牵着孩子并陪同另一名孩子走向列车。

items.meaningZh: 担心；烦恼；忧虑；苦恼；撕咬
items.sentenceEn: She feels worry while waiting for the delayed traveler.
items.sentenceZh: 她等待迟到的旅客时感到担忧。
items.scene: An adult waits near a window at night, holding a cool cup with both hands and glancing anxiously toward an empty, rain-wet path. A friend sits nearby offering calm reassurance. Furrowed brows and tense posture convey worry without melodrama.
items.altText: 夜里，一名成年人焦虑地望向雨中空路，朋友在旁安慰。

items.sentenceEn: A long mountain range crosses the horizon.
items.sentenceZh: 一条绵长的山脉横贯地平线。
items.scene: A panoramic landscape shows one continuous mountain range stretching from the far left edge to the far right edge of the horizon, with many connected peaks and valleys. A tiny cabin in the foreground provides scale.
items.altText: 连绵山峰和山谷从画面左侧一直延伸到右侧地平线。

items.sentenceEn: He will mention the broken window to the caretaker.
items.sentenceZh: 他会向管理员提到那扇破损的窗户。
items.scene: In an apartment corridor, one resident briefly speaks with the caretaker and gestures toward a nearby window with one small visible crack. The caretaker follows his gesture and listens, making the act of mentioning the issue clear without speech bubbles or text.
items.altText: 住户与管理员交谈，并指向旁边有小裂纹的窗户。

items.sentenceEn: The canyon is deep below the viewpoint.
items.sentenceZh: 观景台下方的峡谷很深。
items.scene: From a secure overlook, two adult hikers look across a very deep canyon whose tiny river lies far below between towering layered cliffs. Vertical rock walls and atmospheric distance emphasize depth while a sturdy railing keeps the hikers safe.
items.altText: 观景台下方峡谷垂直而深远，细小河流位于遥远谷底。

items.sentenceEn: The red cup sits near the edge of the table.
items.sentenceZh: 红杯放在桌子的边缘附近。
items.scene: Exactly one red cup sits close to the clearly visible outer edge of a wooden table, with a narrow gap between the cup and boundary. Most of the broad tabletop stretches empty behind it, and the floor is visible beyond the edge.
items.altText: 一只红杯靠近木桌清晰可见的外边缘，后方桌面大面积留空。

items.sentenceEn: The mechanic needs a specific wrench for the small bolt.
items.sentenceZh: 机械师需要一把适合小螺栓的特定扳手。
items.scene: At a repair bench, an adult mechanic compares several clearly different wrench sizes and selects exactly one small wrench that fits one small bolt. Her gaze, hand and the aligned wrench opening all establish the specific required choice.
items.altText: 机械师从不同尺寸的扳手中选出正好适合小螺栓的一把。

items.sentenceEn: The writer develops a new story at her desk.
items.sentenceZh: 这位作家在书桌前构思新故事。
items.scene: An adult writer sits at a desk drafting a story by hand, pauses thoughtfully with a pencil and rearranges several manuscript pages. Books, a desk lamp and a closed typewriter support the literary workspace, but no writing is readable.
items.altText: 作家坐在书桌前用铅笔修改手稿并思考故事。

items.sentenceEn: The delivery van is in trouble on the muddy road.
items.sentenceZh: 送货车在泥泞道路上遇到了麻烦。
items.scene: A small delivery van has one wheel safely stuck in a deep muddy rut on a quiet country road. Two adults inspect the wheel and place traction boards nearby while the van remains stable, clearly showing practical trouble without collision or injury.
items.altText: 送货车车轮陷入泥坑，两人查看并准备用防滑板脱困。

items.sentenceEn: A life jacket is necessary for the canoe trip.
items.sentenceZh: 乘独木舟出行时救生衣是必要的。
items.scene: At a calm lakeshore, three adults prepare one canoe and each securely fastens a bright life jacket before boarding. Their deliberate safety check and the open water ahead make the equipment's necessity clear, with no unsafe comparison.
items.altText: 三人在登上独木舟前认真系紧各自的救生衣。

items.sentenceEn: Small lanterns glow throughout the garden.
items.sentenceZh: 小灯笼遍布花园并发出光亮。
items.scene: At dusk, small warm lanterns are visibly distributed throughout an expansive botanical garden: along the near path, among midground flowerbeds and beside distant trees. Repeated pools of light cover the whole space rather than one cluster.
items.altText: 暖色小灯从近处小路、花坛一直分布到远处树林，遍布整座花园。

items.sentenceEn: The steep climbing wall is a challenge for her.
items.sentenceZh: 陡峭的攀岩墙对她来说是一项挑战。
items.scene: An adult climber wearing a secure harness pauses halfway up a steep indoor climbing wall, studies the next distant hold and reaches with determined effort. A belayer manages the rope safely below, conveying a difficult but achievable challenge.
items.altText: 攀岩者系着安全绳，在陡墙中段努力伸向较远的下一处岩点。

items.sentenceEn: He feels fear before entering the dark cave.
items.sentenceZh: 进入黑暗洞穴前，他感到害怕。
items.scene: At a safe cave entrance in daylight, an adult hiker stops before the dark opening with wide eyes, tense shoulders and one hesitant step backward. A calm companion offers a hand and carries a lantern, showing fear without any visible monster or real threat.
items.altText: 徒步者在黑暗洞口前紧张后退，伙伴提灯伸手安慰。

items.sentenceEn: She carries the canvas bag on her shoulder.
items.sentenceZh: 她把帆布包背在肩上。
items.scene: An adult commuter carries one canvas bag with its wide strap resting clearly on one shoulder. Her upper body is shown in three-quarter view so the shoulder, strap contact and hanging bag are all easy to identify.
items.altText: 通勤者肩部清晰可见，一只帆布包的宽带稳稳搭在肩上。

items.sentenceEn: The library is an important public institution.
items.sentenceZh: 图书馆是重要的公共机构。
items.scene: A welcoming public library is shown in a broad cutaway with coordinated services: adults borrow books, a librarian assists a visitor, children attend a reading circle and another adult uses an accessible study area. The shared building and organized public roles convey an institution.
items.altText: 公共图书馆内借阅、咨询、阅读活动和无障碍学习服务有序进行。

items.sentenceEn: A small red boat rests in the middle of the lake.
items.sentenceZh: 一艘红色小船停在湖中央。
items.scene: From a high centered viewpoint, exactly one small red rowboat rests at the geometric middle of a calm oval lake, with visibly similar distances to the left, right, near and far shores. No other boats appear.
items.altText: 俯视椭圆湖面，一艘红色小船位于距四周湖岸大致相等的中央。

items.sentenceEn: The fishing boat crosses the open sea.
items.sentenceZh: 渔船驶过开阔的海面。
items.scene: One small fishing boat travels across a vast open sea under a broad sky, leaving a gentle wake. Distant coastline is barely visible on the horizon, and uninterrupted blue-green water fills most of the frame.
items.altText: 一艘小渔船驶过广阔海面，蓝绿色海水占据画面大部分。

items.sentenceEn: In her dream, she flies above a quiet city.
items.sentenceZh: 在梦中，她飞过一座安静的城市上空。
items.scene: An adult sleeps peacefully in a dim bedroom while a soft-edged luminous dream vignette rises above the pillow, showing the same woman floating safely above a quiet moonlit city. The distinct real sleeping figure and impossible airy scene make the dream clear.
items.altText: 成年人安静入睡，枕边发光的梦境中她漂浮在月夜城市上空。
